features.name: Scenario list navigation
features.description: The main page shows a SplitView with a left pane listing all 5 scenarios. Selecting a scenario loads its content in the right frame.
expected_behaviour: A ListBox in the left pane displays 5 items: 'Input Events', 'PointerPoint Properties', 'Device Capabilities', 'XAML Manipulations', 'Gesture Recognizer'
Clicking a scenario item loads the corresponding page in the content frame on the right
The currently selected scenario is visually highlighted in the list

features.name: Hamburger menu toggle
features.description: A hamburger toggle button in the header opens/closes the SplitView pane containing the scenario list.
expected_behaviour: A toggle button with the hamburger icon () is visible in the top-left header area
Clicking the toggle button collapses or expands the left navigation pane
The pane starts in the open (IsPaneOpen=True) state

features.name: Pointer Pressed / Released
features.description: A bordered rectangle responds to pointer press and release events by changing background color and displaying status text.
expected_behaviour: A 150x100 LightGray bordered rectangle is displayed with the label 'Pointer Pressed / Released'
Pressing (mouse down) on the rectangle changes its background to RoyalBlue and text to 'Pointer Pressed'
Releasing (mouse up) changes background back to LightGray and text to 'Pointer Released'

features.name: Pointer Enter / Exit
features.description: A bordered rectangle responds to pointer enter and exit events by changing background color and displaying status text.
expected_behaviour: A 150x100 LightGray bordered rectangle is displayed with the label 'Pointer Enter / Exit'
Moving the pointer onto the rectangle changes its background to RoyalBlue and text to 'Pointer Entered'
Moving the pointer off the rectangle changes background back to LightGray and text to 'Pointer Exited'

features.name: Tap / Double-Tap
features.description: A bordered rectangle responds to tap and double-tap gestures with distinct visual feedback.
expected_behaviour: A 150x100 LightGray bordered rectangle is displayed with the label 'Tap / Double-Tap'
A single tap changes background to DeepSkyBlue and text to 'Tapped'
A double-tap changes background to RoyalBlue and text to 'Double-Tapped'

features.name: Right-Tap / Press-and-Hold
features.description: A bordered rectangle responds to holding and right-tap gestures with distinct visual feedback and state transitions.
expected_behaviour: A 150x100 LightGray bordered rectangle is displayed with the label 'Right-Tap / Press-and-Hold'
Press-and-hold starts showing DeepSkyBlue background with text 'Holding'
Completing the hold changes text to 'Held' with LightGray background
Right-click (or hold-release) shows RoyalBlue background with text 'Right Tapped'

features.name: Pointer properties display canvas
features.description: A full-area canvas tracks pointer contacts and displays a floating popup with pointer ID, position, and contact state at the pointer location.
expected_behaviour: An instruction text reads 'Touch or click the screen to see information about the current pointer(s)'
Clicking/touching the canvas creates a popup showing pointer ID, X, Y coordinates, and contact state
The popup follows the pointer position while the button/finger is held down
Releasing removes the popup from the canvas

features.name: Device-specific pointer properties
features.description: The pointer popup displays device-specific properties color-coded by input type: red for mouse, green for touch, yellow for pen.
expected_behaviour: Mouse input shows button states (left, right, middle, X1, X2) and wheel delta in red text
Touch input shows contact rect dimensions (X, Y, Width, Height) in green text
Pen input shows barrel button, eraser, and pressure properties in yellow text

features.name: Keyboard capabilities display
features.description: Displays whether a keyboard is present on the current device.
expected_behaviour: A 'Keyboard Properties' header is shown
Text displays 'Keyboard present = 1' (or 0 if no keyboard)

features.name: Mouse capabilities display
features.description: Displays mouse capability properties including presence, button count, wheel support, and swap status.
expected_behaviour: A 'Mouse Properties' header is shown
Text displays: Mouse present, Number of buttons, Vertical wheel present, Horizontal wheel present, and Buttons swapped values

features.name: Touch capabilities display
features.description: Displays touch capability properties including presence and supported contact count.
expected_behaviour: A 'Touch Properties' header is shown
Text displays: Touch present and Touch contacts supported values

features.name: Rectangle drag and rotate
features.description: A 200x200 LightGray rectangle can be dragged (translated) and rotated via direct manipulation events. It changes color during manipulation.
expected_behaviour: A 200x200 LightGray rectangle is displayed on a Canvas
Dragging the rectangle moves it (translates on X and Y axes)
Multi-touch rotation rotates the rectangle
During manipulation the rectangle turns DeepSkyBlue; during inertia it turns RoyalBlue; when complete it returns to LightGray

features.name: Movement axis selector
features.description: A ComboBox allows restricting manipulation movement to X only, Y only, or both axes.
expected_behaviour: A ComboBox labeled 'Movement Axis' with options: 'X and Y', 'X only', 'Y only'
Default selection is 'X and Y'
Selecting 'X only' restricts dragging to horizontal movement only
Selecting 'Y only' restricts dragging to vertical movement only

features.name: Inertia toggle switch
features.description: A ToggleSwitch enables or disables inertia (momentum) after releasing the manipulated rectangle.
expected_behaviour: A ToggleSwitch labeled 'Inertia' is present and defaults to On
When On, releasing a flick causes the rectangle to continue moving with deceleration
When Off, the rectangle stops immediately when released

features.name: Reset button
features.description: A Reset button returns the rectangle to its original position and resets all manipulation options to defaults.
expected_behaviour: A button labeled 'Reset' is visible
Clicking Reset returns the rectangle to its original position (no transform)
The Movement Axis combo resets to 'X and Y' and Inertia switch resets to On

features.name: GestureRecognizer-based drag and rotate
features.description: A 200x200 rectangle is manipulated via the GestureRecognizer class (not XAML manipulation events). Behaviour mirrors Scenario 4 but uses a lower-level API.
expected_behaviour: A 200x200 LightGray bordered rectangle is displayed on a Canvas
Dragging the rectangle moves it; multi-touch rotates it
During manipulation the rectangle turns DeepSkyBlue; during inertia it turns RoyalBlue; when complete it returns to LightGray

features.name: GestureRecognizer movement axis selector
features.description: A ComboBox allows restricting GestureRecognizer-based movement to X only, Y only, or both axes.
expected_behaviour: A ComboBox labeled 'Movement Axis' with options: 'X and Y', 'X only', 'Y only'
Default selection is 'X and Y'
Selecting 'X only' restricts movement to horizontal; 'Y only' restricts to vertical

features.name: GestureRecognizer inertia toggle
features.description: A ToggleSwitch enables or disables inertia for the GestureRecognizer-based manipulation.
expected_behaviour: A ToggleSwitch labeled 'Inertia' defaults to On
When On, flicking the rectangle causes momentum-based continued movement
When Off, movement stops immediately on release

features.name: GestureRecognizer reset button
features.description: A Reset button returns the GestureRecognizer rectangle to its original state and resets options.
expected_behaviour: A button labeled 'Reset' is visible
Clicking Reset returns the rectangle to original position and resets axis/inertia options to defaults
